findings.title: KDS page silently bounces to POS V4 / cash-overview / pos-orders after ~2 seconds (chef UI is unusable)
evidence: Step 1: GET /admin/kitchen-display-system returns master.blade (KDS bundle loads correctly — verified `hasAppJs: true, hasPosApp: false, htmlLen: 10146`)
Step 2: KDS Vue component mounts, KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue renders empty state with Historique button — captured at 01-kds-board-initial.png
Step 3: Within 1-2 seconds, page URL silently changes to /admin/pos-v4 OR /admin/cash-overview OR /admin/pos-orders without user action
Step 4: Reproduced 5+ times across login cycles
Step 5: Pattern: 12 console errors during navigation, including a 401 cascade that triggers axios interceptor → router.push('auth.login') → staffOnlyMode landing redirect

Step 6: The earliest 403 on /api/admin/kds-order/sync is harmless (re-tried with token, succeeds), but the 401 cascade on /api/admin/cash-overview / /api/admin/cash-sessions-report / etc. triggers `_401Handling` logout (app.js:171-176)
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: app.js axios 401 response interceptor sees parallel 401s from dashboard pre-fetch SDKs (NOT KDS-related) firing on page load, dispatches store/logout, then pushes auth.login — auth.login then redirects to authenticatedStaffLanding() which returns the role's default landing URL (varies based on the previous URL or stale localStorage). The KDS Vue component is the victim of dashboard-prefetch noise from BackendNavbarComponent + DefaultComponent that auto-fires on /admin/* mount.
findings.impact: P0 — chef cannot use the KDS surface; the production-validated HEAL-5 / +N chip / 462px height / WCAG colors / allergen 3-layer code is unreachable through normal navigation
findings.reproduction: 1. Login as admin@lecayenne.fr / 123456 (admin, branch_id=0) 2. Click Écran cuisine sidebar link OR navigate directly to /admin/kitchen-display-system 3. Wait 3-5 seconds 4. Observe URL silently changes to /admin/pos-v4 (most common) or other route 5. Check console: 12+ network errors, multiple 401 cascades
findings.remediation_proposal: (a) Stop dashboard pre-fetch SDKs from firing on routes that are NOT /admin/dashboard. BackendNavbarComponent or shell-level mounted() hooks should branch on $route.path. (b) Make the 401 interceptor in app.js:171-176 ignore non-KDS pre-fetch failures when current $route is admin.kitchen-display-system. (c) Alternative: switch admin auth flow to inject token via session cookie + skip dashboard pre-fetch SDK calls.

findings.title: Initial /api/admin/kds-order/sync 403 on first KDS load (axios send racing token attach)
evidence: Step 1: First navigation to KDS fires /api/admin/kds-order/sync without `x-api-key` header → 400 'Clé API invalide'
Step 2: Or fires with cookie auth but Sanctum stateful flow not initialized → 401
Step 3: ApiKeyMiddleware at app/Http/Middleware/ApiKeyMiddleware.php:23 rejects any request without `x-api-key` header
Step 4: Subsequent calls succeed after axios interceptor injects token (verified by code path)
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: shared/axios-setup.js applies token + x-api-key headers, but a single initial sync call may fire from KitchenDisplaySystemComponent::mounted() before the setup runs, causing one harmless 403/401 that triggers the cascade.
findings.impact: P1 — non-blocking (retry succeeds), but contributes to F-SYS3-1 cascade noise
findings.remediation_proposal: Defer KitchenDisplaySystemComponent::mounted() polling start by 1 tick OR await axios.defaults.headers.common['x-api-key'] presence before starting setInterval.

findings.title: Admin Echo subscription intentionally disabled (branch_id=0 path uses polling only) — no real-time updates for global admin view
evidence: Source: /resources/js/components/admin/kitchenDisplaySystem/KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1896 — `if (branchId <= 0) return; // Admin: polling fallback is sufficient`
Result: admin sees ~3s delay on new orders vs branch staff sub-second push
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Branch isolation via private-branch.{id} channel design — admin has no specific branch channel; would need to subscribe to all branches (broadcast fan-out concern).
findings.impact: P2 — by-design; documented in code. V1.0.2 backlog could expose a `private-admin.global` aggregator channel.
findings.remediation_proposal: Document in operator guide that admin KDS view uses 3-4s polling. For V1.0.2: add server-side aggregator channel `private-kds.admin` that fans out the union of all branch events when admin is connected.
